title: codemother's inspect answers the component-boundary judge by name
intention: INSPECT_JUDGES in cairn/devices/codemother/shim.py lists buildme_stays_in_its_component, so a crossing lane that asks it over the inspect wire is answered, not refused by name.
why: The BUILDME lane (ticket 67d479860f5d) asks the judge (ticket 8d14f4aa9e72) through codemother's inspect verb, and inspect refuses any name off INSPECT_JUDGES before anything runs (shim.py:111-130). The list lives in codemother and the judge in build_inspector, so RULE 1 puts the one line in its own ticket. Proves after the judge, before the lane.
how: One name added to the inspector tuple in INSPECT_JUDGES, with a comment citing 8d14f4aa9e72; a red-first proof asks codemother's inspect for buildme_stays_in_its_component over the bus and is answered (not refused by name), and a name off the list is still refused.

clauses.claim: codemother's inspect asked for buildme_stays_in_its_component over the bus answers with the judge's result, not a refusal naming an unlisted judge
a name not on INSPECT_JUDGES is still refused by name and nothing runs

decisions.text: D1: the INSPECT_JUDGES line, beside the inspector names, citing ticket 8d14f4aa9e72.
D2: the red-first proof, over the inspect wire the way test_codemother_answers_inspect_over_the_bus.py asks it.
